Questions, answered

What is Selo?

A Shopify app that connects your store to WhatsApp for automated order updates, campaigns, AI customer replies and analytics.

Do I need a WhatsApp Business account?

You need a WhatsApp Business Platform account, which you create or connect during setup with your Meta account. The free WhatsApp Business phone app is a different product.

Can I use my existing number?

Yes, if it isn't currently registered on the WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business phone app. Otherwise use a new number or move it off the phone app first.

How long does setup take?

Most stores connect WhatsApp and turn on their first automation in one session. Template approval by WhatsApp is usually quick but can take longer.

Which countries do you support?

Stores and customers anywhere WhatsApp Business Platform messaging is available.
